definition: A Python dictionary maps keys to values. Also known as 'hashes', or 'associative arrays' in other programming languages.
Edges are either two-tuples of nodes (u, v) or three tuples of nodes with an edge attribute dictionary (u, v, dict).
An iterable container of edge tuples like a list, iterator, or file.
Edges can have arbitrary Python objects assigned as attributes by using keyword/value pairs when adding an edge assigning to the G.edges[u][v] attribute dictionary for the specified edge u-v.

An nbunch is a single node, container of nodes or None (representing all nodes). It can be a list, set, graph, etc. To filter an nbunch so that only nodes actually in G appear, use G.nbunch_iter(nbunch).
A node can be any hashable Python object except None.
Nodes can have arbitrary Python objects assigned as attributes by using keyword/value pairs when adding a node or assigning to the G.nodes[n] attribute dictionary for the specified node n.
A directed graph where edges have a direction. Created with nx.DiGraph().
A graph allowing multiple edges between the same pair of nodes. nx.MultiGraph() for undirected.
Square matrix A where A[i][j]=1 if edge (i,j) exists. nx.adjacency_matrix(G).
Fraction of nodes a node is connected to. nx.degree_centrality(G).
Fraction of shortest paths through a node. Identifies bridges. nx.betweenness_centrality(G).
Reciprocal of average shortest path distance to all other nodes. nx.closeness_centrality(G).
Maximal subgraph where every pair is connected by a path. nx.connected_components(G).
In a digraph, every node reachable from every other. nx.strongly_connected_components(G).
Path with minimum total weight. nx.shortest_path(G, source, target).
Fraction of neighbor pairs that are also neighbors. nx.clustering(G).
Nodes divide into two sets with edges only between sets. nx.bipartite module.
Directed Acyclic Graph: no cycles. nx.is_directed_acyclic_graph(G).
Linear ordering where for every edge (u,v), u before v. nx.topological_sort(G).
L = D - A. Eigenvalues encode connectivity. nx.laplacian_matrix(G).
Probability of arriving at node via random walk. nx.pagerank(G).
Tree connecting all nodes with minimum total weight. nx.minimum_spanning_tree(G).
